name: Curative Mastery (Item Mastery, Mythic)
body:
You can convert magical energy to cure multiple characters and even to revive the dead.

Prerequisite(s): Curative MasteryHH.

Benefit(s): You gain an additional daily use of Curative Mastery for every odd mythic tier you possess. You can cause an item used with Curative Mastery to cast a conjuration (healing) spell of any level, spending a number of daily uses of Curative Mastery equal to the level of the desired spell. By spending one use of mythic power, you can instead cause the item to cast the mythic version of the spell.
